title: Curtains for a street-facing room

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: With both curtains closed, this room feels gloomy. The white inner curtain softens the afternoon sun, but last night my neighbour could see my desk from the pavement.
turns.zh: 兩層窗簾都拉上時，房間有點昏暗。白色內層窗簾會讓午後陽光柔和一些，可昨晚鄰居從人行道看得到我的書桌。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Was your desk lamp on? In daylight that curtain hides the desk from straight ahead, but not from the bakery steps across the road.
turns.zh: 當時書桌的燈有開嗎？白天從正前方看，那層窗簾能遮住書桌；但從馬路對面麵包店的台階看就不行。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Yes, I was reading. I need daylight while I work, but deliveries come from those steps.
turns.zh: 有，我當時在看書。我工作時需要日光，但送貨的人會從那些台階過來。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Move the desk behind the bookcase first. Keep the inner curtain for daylight, and draw the heavy one when you switch the lamp on.
turns.zh: 先把書桌移到書櫃後方。白天用內層窗簾，開書桌燈時就拉上厚窗簾。
